integrity: Analytical convexity and monotonicity prove the global classification. Symbolic and exact-rational stationary-generator checks reproduce the cumulant. No independent audit or validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only a single linear damped oscillator, positive damping and symmetric fixed-amplitude Markov telegraph forcing; instantaneous stationary fourth cumulant, not a density theorem. Existing general moment methods are prior art. Full text of a highly relevant 1987 article was unavailable for exhaustive historical comparison.
title: A unique damping threshold for reentrant stationary kurtosis in a telegraph-driven oscillator
